responsibility: This source file implements the MIPS target hooks needed by the GCC D front end. It registers D built-in version identifiers based on MIPS word size, ABI, and floating-point ABI, and it provides TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO handling for traits such as getTargetInfo("floatAbi"), thereby translating MIPS backend configuration into the D front end’s target-version and target-info model.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the peer header mips-d.h, this .cc file contains the executable MIPS-specific D front-end hook logic itself: it computes and registers D version identifiers and target-info values from backend state such as TARGET_64BIT, mips_abi, and the float ABI.
